selected_claims.content: (d) graph classification on MUTAG: GCN 83.54 ± 0.40 accuracy with 4.8K parameters vs QGCN 88.61 ± 0.66 accuracy with 4.4K parameters.
on OGBN-Arxiv node classification, GCN achieves 72.8 ± 1.5 accuracy with 145.1K parameters versus QGCN 72.3 ± 1.6 with 43.5K parameters;
on OGBG-COLLAB link prediction, QGCN achieves Hits@50 45.80 ± 1.35 with 6.4K parameters compared to GCN 44.02 ± 1.57 with 12.5K parameters.
(a) node classification on Cora: real GCN 85.2 ± 1.3 accuracy with 140.5K parameters vs QGCN 84.1 ± 1.5 accuracy with 42.1K parameters;
(b) node classification on PubMed: GCN 79.1 ± 1.2 with 131.9K parameters vs QGCN 78.4 ± 1.4 with 41.7K parameters;
(c) link prediction on CORA: GCN ROC-AUC 79.27 ± 0.47 with 96.0K parameters vs QGCN ROC-AUC 83.55 ± 0.03 with 27.2K parameters;
